svg.aria-label: Open localhost:3000: pnpm run dev serves the app on localhost:3000 (http://localhost:3000). CSP blocks eval under next dev: Client components (counters, keyboard shortcuts) do not hydrate locally. Check interactive behaviour with pnpm run build && pnpm start
